blurb: Guests enjoy private, comfortable cruises on the Ohio River aboard the vessel Miss Liberty, departing from Four Seasons Marina. Cruises are BYOB with Bluetooth sound system, clean seating, and a restroom onboard. Tours are tailored for small groups up to 6 guests and offer scenic, laid-back routes with options for extended or special themed cruises.
extraNote: Cruises rain or shine; may cancel up to 60 minutes before departure for severe weather with store credit offered · No smoking or vaping onboard · Head Boat Area at Four Seasons Marina, 4853 Kellogg Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45226
